scope: Installed Python S02 whole-product sequence only; not the full Phase 1 protocol
candidate_source_note: The paired wheel was built from 8587b0571f4e6477045e60ddd341b0cd28f5a3cb after the four search/graph repairs and Python frozen-error repair. Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/rust and src/python are byte-identical between that commit and the Slice 135 freeze checkout; later Slice 135 commits changed measurement and documentation files only. Recheck before execution.
database: Fresh real SQLite database and fresh Python process per sequence
timing_boundary: Installed Python Engine.open invocation through materialized post-erasure and reopened state and reopened close; direct SQLite verification and semantic assertions excluded
percentile_rule: Sort all 100 valid per-version samples; nearest-rank index ceil(p*n)-1, without trimming. Also report each block's median and complete observed range.
uncertainty_rule: Report every one of the five pair deltas, their median and complete range. Five pairs do not support a significance or equivalence claim.
resource_rule: Retain GNU Time child CPU, peak RSS, filesystem block I/O, major faults and swaps for every fresh process. Report per-version resource distributions without attributing whole-process cost to one stage.
invalid_block_rule: Preserve all attempts. Require a clean exact-source checkout, verified installed wheel and native bytes, frozen protocol and runner hashes, exactly 20 valid measured samples plus one valid warmup, expected state and counts, stable host/kernel/CPU/storage/governor/toolchain, no named competing jobs, at least 1 GiB free and zero measured-child swap events. Host-only swap drift is a warning with a sensitivity result. Do not replace a failed sample silently; invalidate and retain its block and pair.
candidate_verdict_rule: Diagnostic latency comparison only. Report regression/improvement and observed uncertainty separately from accepted release gates; version agreement is not a correctness oracle.
phase1_limit: This Python S02 subset does not close TypeScript/Rust, S01/S03/C01, contention, Pareto coverage, robustness or logic/exception matrices.
